name: Discord Overlay
author: ynnad
description: Discord-style overlay: voice channel members that light up while talking (with mute/deafen icons), everyone else's Go Live streams tiled to fit, and a live PS5/Xbox controller view. Super+Tab to move, resize or remove widgets. Includes a bar icon to turn it on and off.

barWidget.description: Turn the Discord overlay on and off. Right-click to edit its layout.
